page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top: "APPENDIX." with page number at top right. Below it, a full-width title in capitals, then a centred italic greeting, then one body paragraph with a large initial H, and a closing "Datum" at the lower right. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.l: storiae, perquam accuratè à te Latinitate do-
natum, una cum litteris tuis accepimus, opus
sanè luculentum, propter quod Latini non pa-
puè hii, qui fortium virorum res, rem profe-
lebrati Auctoris vestigiis innitentes, in lu-
brico solo pedem firmius ponere possunt. Iam-
que Nos, si quid perpetuitate dignum geri-
mus, sub Luciani tui leges, à summi ingenii
viris descriptum, fidem apud posteros confe-
cuturum non desperamus: idque totum vi-
giliis tuis adscribimus, & merito pro tanto

page.notes: The initial H is a large woodcut-style letter and is joined to "onorabilis" as "Honorabilis". The "ct" in "Auctoris" is a ligature in the print. The page number is read as 293. The page ends at "Datum"; the rest of the date line is not printed on this page.
